facts.text: The country’s two main islands lie near Venezuela.
Trinidad’s Northern Range runs along the island’s northern coast.

culture.text: Carnival brings costumed street parades together with steelband, calypso, and soca music.

food.name: Doubles
food.text: Curried chickpeas are tucked between two pieces of fried flatbread and served with condiments.
